description: This file implements Windows-specific network management functions for Kubernetes, including network, endpoint, and load balancer handling via HNS (Host Networking Service). It defines interfaces and methods for managing network resources, endpoints, and load balancers on Windows.

classes.name: hns
classes.description: Struct representing the HNS service interface for managing network resources.

methods.name: getNetworkByName
methods.description: Retrieves network information by name, including remote subnets.

methods.name: getAllEndpointsByNetwork
methods.description: Lists all endpoints associated with a specified network.

methods.name: getEndpointByID
methods.description: Retrieves endpoint details by endpoint ID.

methods.name: getEndpointByIpAddress
methods.description: Finds an endpoint by its IP address within a specified network.

methods.name: getEndpointByName
methods.description: Retrieves endpoint details by endpoint name.

methods.name: createEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a new endpoint in a specified network.

methods.name: deleteEndpoint
methods.description: Deletes an endpoint by its ID.

methods.name: getAllLoadBalancers
methods.description: Lists all load balancers managed by HNS.

methods.name: getLoadBalancer
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a load balancer for given endpoints and configuration.

methods.name: updateLoadBalancer
methods.description: Updates an existing load balancer with new configuration.

methods.name: deleteLoadBalancer
methods.description: Deletes a load balancer by its ID.

methods.name: hashEndpoints
methods.description: Generates a hash from a list of endpoint IDs or endpointInfo objects.

methods.name: findLoadBalancerID
methods.description: Constructs a unique load balancer ID based on endpoints and configuration.
